Inputs like u, k, c, t or 3 after a 1 mostly do not fire it. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.124, max 0.223); the top activations are on i/<DEL>/m/w after "1 1" or "p 1" contexts and on re-input i when first_tok is i. Most steps after a 1 do not fire (precision 1.7% for prev_tok==1 & t<=5), so the true trigger is a narrow combination of recent tokens that a simple predicate does not capture.
